card.text: Explore Agenor in 3D with its published shape model and radial elevation.

introduction.text: Jupiter Trojan in the L5 trailing cloud. Convex light-curve reconstruction. The grid marks unavailable surface imagery.

shape.title: Agenor · DAMIT 4273 convex shape
shape.summary: Convex light-curve reconstruction with approximate thermal size: 50.799 km effective diameter (fit ±1.181 km; additional shape and thermal-model uncertainty). Thermal size is used as a volume-scale approximation; grid marks unavailable imagery.

elevation.title: Agenor · source-model radial height
elevation.summary: Radius on the shape model minus a 25.3995 km reference sphere, in false color. Heights inherit the size uncertainty; this is not independent topography or gravitational height.
